sam: Heads up — PR #4231 docs update for streaming fallback example is blocked. CI preview failing because the snippet assumes the runtime will forward X-Model-Fallback header when the request falls back to a smaller model. Is that true? I couldn't find authoritative runtime behavior in the model-routing docs. @matthew @jess
docs-ci-bot: preview build failed -> docs-pr-4231/snippet-test: assert header present -> /site/snippets/fallback.md:line 32
jess: Link please?
sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4231
Snippet in question:
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Model: big-model-v1" -H "X-Prefer-Fallback: true" https://api.redwood.ai/generate | jq -r '.headers["X-Model-Fallback"]'
```
Test expects a non-empty value
matthew: Runtime historically returns X-Model-Fallback on the outbound response when a fallback happened, but only for non-streaming responses I think. For streaming we attach model tags in the stream chunks, not the response header. @linh can you confirm?
linh: Confirming: current runtime sets X-Model-Fallback header only when finalizing the response (non-stream). For streaming (response_mode=stream) we do not set that header because chunks are sent earlier. We emit a JSON control event in stream: "{\"event\":\"model.swap\",\"from\":\"big-model-v1\",\"to\":\"small-model-quant\"}" — not an HTTP header. This was an intentional design choice to avoid buffering. We could add header if we buffer the whole output, but that would add latency.
sam: Oof, tests rely on header. Should we change snippet to parse stream control event? Is that allowed in docs?
jess: Docs should show recommended approach. For streaming users we should demonstrate inspecting control events. For non-streaming show header. Can we update snippet to be conditional / show both?
matthew: Agree. Also need runtime team to signoff on wording: 'fallback may be signaled via header OR streaming control event depending on response_mode'. Linh, can you approve copy?
linh: SGTM. Quick suggested text: 'If you call the API with response_mode=stream, model swaps are signaled inside the stream as control events (e.g., model.swap). For non-streaming responses, the runtime sets X-Model-Fallback on the final HTTP response.' Happy to approve.
sam: I'll update PR with two snippets and push. Removing merge hold after CI green. Thanks all :tada:

docs-ci-bot: preview build passed — snippets test OK
jess: :shipit:
